keyEvents.text: Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 0. Givairo Read (Feyenoord) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jerayno Schaken.
Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 1. Mario Domínguez (Excelsior) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ágúst Thorsteinsson with a through ball.
Goal! Feyenoord 1, Excelsior 2. Irakli Yegoian (Excelsior) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
